name: Puzzles
description: Daily word-game help tied to the calendar: hints and answers for The New York Times Connections and similar puzzles, published the day each puzzle goes live. Every story gives the puzzle number and date, offers graded hints before any answer so readers can stop early, explains the trickiest overlaps, and puts the full solution in a clearly marked section at the end. Answers are checked against more than one source before publishing. Stories link to the day's date guide and the monthly printable calendar.
